text.tspan: Dietary land use vs. beef consumption2011
The percentage of global habitable land area needed for agriculture if the total world population was to adopt
the average diet of any given country versus annual per capita beef consumption. Globally we use
approximately 50% of habitable land for agriculture, as shown by the grey horizontal line.
Data source: Alexander et al. (2016); Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
Note: Figures show beef supply and do not correct for waste at the household level and, so they may not directly reflect the quantity of food
consumed by a given individual. Where data for 2011 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1991 and 2023 is shown instead.
